My Wedding Photography

Work With Me

Hi, I'm Jo — a wedding photographer based in Dundee, Scotland. I believe your wedding photographs should feel as real and emotional as the day itself. No stiff poses, no forced smiles — just genuine moments, beautifully captured.

Whether you're planning an intimate ceremony or a grand celebration across the Scottish Highlands, I'd love to be there to tell your story. Get in touch and let's chat about your day.
